name: web-research
description: Live web research for the agent (opt-in, needs an API key).

commands.name: research
commands.description: Run deep research on a topic
commands.template: Run thorough research on: {input}. Use web_search and fetch_url for real sources, then write a structured brief with citations.

commands.name: cite
commands.description: Verify sources and quote the evidence
commands.template: Verify the sources for: {input}. Return each claim with a direct URL, publication date and the quoted passage; mark anything unverified.

commands.name: compare
commands.template: Compare the sources on: {input}. Use a table of claim, source, date and agreement; state where the sources conflict.

changelog: 1.1.0 - DoD pass: skill pack with two examples, commands, changelog and README entry.
